a: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا
فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
m: Apabila datang pertolongan Allah dan kemenangan (semasa engkau wahai Muhammad berjaya menguasai negeri Makkah)
Dan engkau melihat manusia masuk dalam ugama Allah beramai-ramai
Maka ucapkanlah tasbih dengan memuji Tuhanmu dan mintalah ampun kepadaNya, sesungguhnya Dia amat menerima taubat
e: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest
And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes
Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance
t: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan
Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban
